name: Local GitHub for Math (mathematical knowledge base)

mentions.name: Local GitHub for Math (mathematical knowledge base)
mentions.description: This project provides a mathematical knowledge base described as a local GitHub for math, with a Forgejo instance as the backend. It keeps mathematical writing as plain Markdown while adding stable IDs, backlinks, search, draft changes, review, approvals, and merge. It includes a frontend for humans and a harness for AI agents that automatically consume the knowledge base and expand on it, with agents reading pages, following references, proposing edits, and going through the same Issue/PR/review workflow as humans. It works with natural-language proofs rather than formalization, aiming to be useful before autoformalization matures and afterward as a place where humans and agents organize exploration.
mentions.problem: Helping mathematicians do math together with humans/AI today, in areas not yet easy to formalize because they are not in mathlib.
mentions.audience: Mathematicians who want to do math together with humans and AI today.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a mathematical knowledge base software.

It's kinda like a local Github for math. In fact the backend is actually a Forgejo instance, I'm building a frontend for human and also a harness for agents that automatically consumes the knowledge base and expand on it.
